# Occasia

> Turnkey Event Management, Scenic Fabrication, and Experiential Production.

Occasia is an experiential event production and management company based in New Delhi, India. We engineer immersive live environments with structural precision, creative originality, and meticulous operational management for enterprise brands, industry associations, and private milestone celebrations.

## Core Services

- Corporate Conferences & Summits: Annual general meetings, keynote sessions, multiscreen projection, stage telemetry, and speaker coordination.
- Experiential Brand Activations: Pop-up pavilions, product launch test-zones, interactive photo installations, and high-visibility brand environments.
- Stage Fabrication & Scenic Architecture: In-house scenic carpentry, heavy-duty certified trussing, architectural backdrops, and customized wooden/metal sets built from CAD drawings.
- BTL Field Campaigns & Roadshows: Pan-regional mobile marketing vans, mall concourse activations, sampling setups, and consumer engagement drives.
- Wedding & Gala Decor: Thematic floral installations, architectural mandap structures, ambient lighting design, and curated spatial decor.
- Technical Audiovisual Systems: High-density LED walls, line array acoustic distribution, broadcast camera switching, and intelligent lighting rigs.
